Network+ N10-009 Practice Tests and Study Guide

NetPlus Academy is a free Network+ N10-009 practice test and study guide course: forty-nine lessons mapped to the exam objectives, a printable memorization sheet of ports, protocols, and subnetting, tutorials built from what you miss, and unlimited practice tests in the exam's format. Use it as a Network+ study guide on its own, or work through the N10-009 practice questions bank lesson by lesson.

PassingThe real exam passes at 720 on a 100 to 900 scale. This course's official-format test uses 80%, that score divided by 900.
Course49 lessons across 9 units, about 6.9 hours of reading

How the course works

  1. Cheat sheet. Everything the exam expects you to recall cold, printable.
  2. Starter test. A few questions per exam domain, with a confidence rating on each.
  3. Your tutorial. Lessons chosen from what you missed or guessed, each with a checkpoint and a deeper explanation.
  4. Practice tests and retraining. 50 questions, weighted like the real exam. Every miss is explained and feeds back into your lessons.
  5. 3 of your last 5 at 80%. That unlocks one full-length test on the real exam's clock: 90 questions in 90 minutes, at its real passing score of 80%. Pass it once and you are ready to book.

Questions people ask

How many questions are on the Network+ N10-009 exam?

Up to 90 questions in 90 minutes, a mix of multiple choice and performance-based items. The passing score is 720 on a scale of 100 to 900.

What does the exam cover?

Networking concepts, network implementation, network operations, network security, and network troubleshooting, in CompTIA's published weights. The course's practice tests use the same weights.

How much does Network+ cost?

See CompTIA's current voucher price; the course itself is free.

How does this course decide I am ready?

Three of your last five fifty-question practice tests at 80% or better, then one ninety-question test at the real passing score of 720 of 900.

Can I read the lessons without signing up?

The first fifteen lessons and the cheat sheet are open on this site; the full course, with checkpoints and practice tests, is free inside the app.
